title: Absolute Cinema
description: It adds a cinematic effect to the game
body:
Absolute Cinema v1.0
This pack is built for one thing: making Minecraft look and sound like a high-budget movie. It scraps the basic vanilla feel for massive mountain ranges, realistic physics, and a layer of sound that actually makes the world feel alive.

What’s Inside
World Gen: Tectonic and Terralith working together to create massive peaks and natural-looking valleys.

Visuals: Fully optimized with Sodium and Iris. It’s set up for Distant Horizons, so you can see for miles without your frame rate tanking.

Audio: AmbientSounds 6 provides the atmosphere, while Sound Physics Remastered handles the echoes in caves and muffled sounds behind walls.

Immersion: First-person body models and Presence Footsteps so you actually feel grounded in the world.

Details: Water ripples, falling leaves, and better ground clutter to fill out the empty spaces.

Specs
The "It Runs" Tier

CPU: Intel Core i5-6600K / Ryzen 5 1600

GPU: GTX 1060 (6GB) / RX 580

RAM: 4GB Allocated

The "Absolute Cinema" Tier

CPU: Intel Core i7-10700K / Ryzen 7 5800X

GPU: RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT

RAM: 6GB to 8GB Allocated

Storage: Use an SSD or don't complain about stuttering.

Before you install...
I am not responsible for your brick of a PC exploding under the impact of shaders, so don't argue with me about that. This pack is heavy. If your laptop starts smelling like burnt toast, turn the settings down.

Version: 1.21.1
